game.name: Start Citron
game.desc: Opens the Citron (Nintendo Switch) GUI so you can install firmware, manage your prod.keys/title.keys and change settings - run this after Install Citron to finish setup. Drop your keys in /storage/roms/bios/keys (this launcher links that folder into Citron's data dir) and install firmware from the GUI. A mouse and keyboard are recommended for the interface. Citron is an experimental open-source Nintendo Switch emulator.

game.name: Install Citron
game.desc: Downloads the latest Citron (Nintendo Switch) arm64 nightly AppImage from github.com/citron-neo/CI and installs it into the writable storage tree. Nothing is bundled in the firmware. After installing, run "Start Citron" to open the GUI and install firmware, drop your prod.keys/title.keys in /storage/roms/bios/keys, add Switch games to /storage/roms/switch, then restart EmulationStation - the Nintendo Switch section appears once games are present. Citron is an experimental open-source Nintendo Switch emulator.

game.name: Update Citron
game.desc: Pulls the latest Citron (Nintendo Switch) arm64 nightly AppImage, keeping the previous one for rollback. A size and ELF integrity check runs before the new build is activated. Idempotent: skips if you already have the latest nightly.

game.name: Rollback Citron
game.desc: Reverts the managed Citron install. If a previous version was kept it swaps current and previous; otherwise it removes the managed AppImage. Use this if a freshly updated Citron crashes when launching a game.

game.name: Uninstall Citron
game.desc: Removes the downloaded Citron AppImage(s). Your keys, saves and config under /storage/roms/bios/citron and /storage/.config/citron are kept. The Nintendo Switch section disappears once its ROM folder is empty (or after restarting EmulationStation).
